name: 02050 · Marshfield, MA
findings: ZIP 02050 (Marshfield) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02050 (Marshfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02050 (Marshfield) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
